sources.entry: Clippy - Smart clipboard manager with content-aware previews, AI transformations, a built-in screenshot editor, and file converter. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/yarasaa/Clippy) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Clippy is an open-source, local-first clipboard manager for macOS with card-based history, a built-in screenshot editor, OCR search, and optional AI text transformations.
summary.what_it_does: Clippy keeps a searchable history of everything copied (text, URLs, colors, JSON, code, images) and shows smart previews for each type. It runs Apple Vision OCR on copied images so text inside screenshots is searchable, and Screen Text Grab (⇧⌘2) copies text from any screen region. A Studio-style screenshot editor offers 20+ annotation tools, and a Quick Preview overlay (⌘⌥V) pastes recent items by number key. Snippets expand from ;keyword triggers with placeholders, fill-in parameters and global variables. AI transformations can use Apple Intelligence, Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google Gemini, and a file converter handles image, document, audio, video and data formats. The README says data stays on the Mac in CoreData with no telemetry, and locked items are AES-GCM encrypted with a key in the Keychain.
use_cases: Grab text from a screenshot or video frame
Expand text snippets and templates with a keyword
Transform or summarize clipboard text with AI
notable: On-device OCR makes copied screenshots searchable without setup
Ask-your-clipboard natural-language search that pulls exact values verbatim from original text
Snippets with dynamic placeholders, fill-in forms and nested snippet expansion
Locked items encrypted with AES-GCM and key stored in Keychain, with Touch ID prompts
caveats: Requires macOS 13+ to build; Apple Intelligence provider needs macOS 26+
Cloud AI providers need the user's own API key and send data to that provider
README links PRIVACY.md as 'coming soon' and does not include it
keywords: free alternative to paid clipboard app
